content: {"phoneNote":"The hero works, but below it the page repeats itself: opening hours, address, phone and 'Navodila za pot' all appear twice between the contact section and the footer.","desktopNote":"Arched photos and the 'Mia' watermark give the hero character, yet the lower page is thin: a five-item price grid with an empty second row, a 'Ljudje v salonu' section with only two names in a large pink band, and duplicated hours and address in the footer.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Drop the opening-hours table and address block from the footer (or from the sections above) so each contact fact appears once; keep only the name, legal data and policy links in the footer.","Give 'Ljudje v salonu' portraits of Mia and Ana or fold the two names into the contact section; as it stands it is a near-empty pink band on both screens.","Rebalance the price grid (e.g. 3+2 or a single list with dotted leaders) and tighten the dead space under the desktop hero and between the cenik link and the photos on phone."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: the opening-hours table is shown in full in 'Kdaj nas obiščete' and again in the footer 'Delovni čas'.","Phone and desktop: address with 'Navodila za pot' and the phone number are repeated in the contact section and again in the footer 'Obiščite nas'."]}
